audit.why: Early is Sylas-favored (Q double-tap + W sustain), Ryze flips at first item and outscales — matches winRate 50.44 and content layer.
Spikes (Lvl 3-5 Sylas, Lvl 6 Hijack, 1st item flip, late Ryze) are accurate and all 4 entries exist.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; full-layer level chart said Skill on rows where content, packet and prose all say Sylas.
audit.why: Sylas E is 13s rank 1 / 9s max, W 12s early, R Hijack 80/55/30; Ryze W 11s. Chart rows 0,2,3,4 are Sylas per packet and content win[].
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added; full phases[0/2/3/4].side moved to Sylas with matching why/rating rewrites (win[] already agrees — side-only per chart rule).

audit.why: missingInteractions flagged anti-heal vs Kingslayer; report[8].t already instructs early anti-heal.

edits.before: Q-farm at max range — your level 1 is honest at best. Bank Tear stacks and give nothing away.
edits.after: His Chain Lash hits twice and outdamages your lone Overload — farm at max range and bank Tear stacks.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E gives you E-Q flux chunks, but his Q-W-E combo with Kingslayer healing still wins any extended trade.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: His Abduct all-in and Kingslayer sustain keep the pressure his — short-trade with EQ and walk away before he answers.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Hijack steals Realm Warp and his all-in still outdamages you — shove and warp only with his E and R accounted for.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Rune Prison like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas E Abscond/Abduct: 13s at rank 1, 9s max — his only gap-closer; punish hard while it's down. - W Kingslayer heal runs 12s early. - Guard your W Rune Prison (11s) like a fifth summoner. - Hijack falls to 30s late.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: A centered wave denies his E Abduct angle from fog — flank wards turn his 13s-cooldown dash into a coin he can't flip.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: At half HP one E-Q-W rotation with Petricite Burst autos kills you — the stack you greed is the one he collects on.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP is the map-game backbone. Nothing else is defensible on him.
